GeneBench-Pro: Evaluating Multistage Statistical Reasoning in Genomics, Quantitative Biology, and Translational Biomedicine · paper method: The authors’ manual review of selected GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol reasoning traces suggests a notice-act gap: failures may identify local diagnostics without sufficiently revising downstream statistical methods or QC.

The study procedurally generates counting, graph and spatial problems, calibrates difficulty using ten models, and compares 100/200/500-example easy versus mixed subsets while fine-tuning Qwen3-4B with LoRA and GRPO under fixed task budgets. Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The study uses fictional company environments, expert-mutated policies, mock services and one common OpenHands harness under explicit call/time caps. Policy mutation is intended to resist memorization; the protocol does not by itself prove uncontaminated pretraining or establish naturalistic corporate compliance and safety outside these tasks.

repair.qualbinding.20261111.v1.mandatory3.claim.arxiv.2607.25398.limitation

  • This is a source-specific, first-party description; this repair does not independently reproduce experiments or audit operational execution and customer outcomes.
  • Experts adapt ten industry handbooks into 65 fictional-company tasks with per-task operative policy mutations. Handbooks span 20-124 rendered pages and arrive as PDF, Word or HTML.
  • Eight hundred twenty-four deterministic Python criteria check final workspace/service state, including required outputs and prohibited behavior. No LLM judging is used; strict pass requires all criteria, with four trials per task and a separate N-minus-one metric.
  • Task builders iterate tasks and criteria against repeated model runs. A common OpenHands harness caps each trial at 200 tool calls and one hour; provider/transport errors are excluded and rerun.
  • July Table 2 has thirty configurations, while the cost/efficiency section refers to twenty configurations evaluated at release. Strict and relaxed metrics remain separate.
  • Industry-policy inspiration and mock services do not constitute observation of actual private corporate work or an independent audit of pretraining contamination or deployment safety.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The paper post-trains Qwen3.5-122B-A10B on 363 MCP tasks using a selected 3000-trajectory Kimi K2.6 supervised warmup followed by one-epoch RL. Deterministic criterion rewards are combined with a low-score effort floor capped at 0.40; evaluation uses native benchmark scores rather than this shaping reward.

repair.qualbinding.20261111.v1.mandatory3.claim.arxiv.2608.00181.method

  • This is a source-specific, first-party description; this repair does not independently reproduce experiments or audit operational execution and customer outcomes.
  • This is one combined SFT-then-RL experiment; the stages are not isolated, and no no-effort-floor ablation was run.
  • Toolathlon influenced the initial base-family/teacher choices and contributed reused MCP surfaces. External tasks and graders are excluded from post-training according to the authors; base pretraining cannot be audited.
  • Updated greedy results and accepted-paper snapshots have distinct provenance. Native four-sample diagnostics are not identified with standard unweighted any-of-four pass@4; one run, correlated benchmarks and unavailable paired units limit uncertainty claims.
  • Deterministic Python final-state criteria supply reward. Kimi K2.6 generated the selected 3,000 warmup trajectories, and the low-score effort floor is capped at 0.40.
  • Claude Opus 4.8 assisted root-cause reports, after which authors checked raw trajectories. Exploratory outcome-conditioned behavioral patterns and correlations do not establish a causal transfer mechanism.

The study describes a combined SFT-plus-GSPO post-training experiment on 363 LHMTA office/general-tool tasks, followed by analysis of 103 base-fail/trained-pass task pairs using Claude Opus 4.8-assisted reports manually checked against raw trajectories. repair.qualbinding.20261111.v1.mandatory3.claim.arxiv.2608.01604.method

  • This is a source-specific, first-party description; this repair does not independently reproduce experiments or audit operational execution and customer outcomes.
  • The study uses 363 office/general-tool training tasks, deterministic Python final-state criteria, 3,000 selected Kimi K2.6 warmup trajectories and SFT followed by GSPO on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B.
  • Claude Opus 4.8 assists root-cause reports that authors manually check against raw trajectories. The analysis selects 103 base-fail/trained-pass tasks and does not estimate general capability prevalence.
  • Retrieval-span overlap, reference-patch overlap, patch size and formal-test commands are indirect behavioral proxies. Reference patches are not unique ground truth; all results use one model/training run without task-demand ablation or an equal-budget software-training counterfactual.
  • This paper describes reward as trajectory-level criterion fraction. Companion 2608.00181v1 additionally reports a low-score effort floor and Toolathlon-informed initial family/teacher choice; the two protocol descriptions are not silently equated.
  • Matching model, 363-task/3,000-trajectory recipe and reported values suggest shared experimental provenance with 2608.00181v1. This is an author inference; the work identities remain separate and independent experimental replication is not established.

  • Healthcare professional times are creator range estimates, averaged at midpoints with more-than-40 capped at 40. The finance mean is separately reported on its dataset card; the healthcare estimation convention is not asserted for finance.
  • Section 5.3 cost covers agent/condenser model calls and excludes the judge. It is not interpreted as an all-in service price or observed labor saving.
